items.title: House Democrat targets candidate prediction market trades after opponent’s Kalshi penalty
items.summary: With less than a month until the midterm elections , prediction markets ' political contracts are in focus as observers look to see if they'll accurately forecast who will win various races across the country.

items.title: Brazilian stocks jump as Bolsonaro now seen as heavy favorite to win presidency
items.summary: Brazilians will decide in just under three weeks whether to reelect incumbent president Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva or oust him in favor of Flávio Bolsonaro — the son of former president Jair Bolsonaro — as both advanced to a runoff after receiving the most votes in the first-round vote on Sunday.

items.title: The 2029 tipping point: Western populations are about to start shrinking, piling pressure on public finances
items.summary: As Western populations age, fewer workers and higher costs will strain public finances, credit rating agency Moody's has warned.
